## Standing operator rules
Never let config/ or deploy/ contain a TOML, YAML, or JSON file longer than 120 lines without extracting values into ledgerly_defaults.py.

Separate procedure, run steps in order, one at a time: check/back up source; start/secure target; deploy dual-write; backfill; reconcile; pause source writes; switch app; smoke test; disable old write path.

Webhook retry decorator with 5 attempts is ruled out; it re-sent customer emails.
